classification.difficultyReason: The hardest part requires translating two compound intersections into Venn regions, combining them to recognise everything outside B, then applying the outer complement. The specified diagram method scaffolds this linked interpretation, although nested simplification has not been demonstrated.

content.prompt: Use Venn diagrams to simplify each of the following events or express in a different form.

answer.worked:
Shade the part of $A$ outside $B$ and the overlap of $A$ and $B$. Together these cover all of $A$.
$$ (A\cap B^{\mathrm c})\cup(A\cap B)=A. $$

spec.description: Complete solution Venn diagram; all of A is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Union of A outside B with A intersect B equals A.

answer.worked:
Shade the region outside both circles. It belongs to both complements.
$$(A\cup B)^{\mathrm c}=A^{\mathrm c}\cap B^{\mathrm c}.$$

spec.description: Complete solution Venn diagram; only the region outside both circles is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Complement of the union equals intersection of the complements.

answer.worked:
Shade every region except the overlap of the two circles. These outcomes are outside $A$ or outside $B$.
$$(A\cap B)^{\mathrm c}=A^{\mathrm c}\cup B^{\mathrm c}.$$

spec.description: Complete solution Venn diagram; only the region outside both circles is shaded.
spec.mathematics: The approved inventory preserves the same complemented union as part b.

answer.worked:
The $B$-only region and the $A$-only region have no common region. No outcome can belong to both $A$ and $A^{\mathrm c}$.
$$(A^{\mathrm c}\cap B)\cap(A\cap B^{\mathrm c})=\varnothing.$$

spec.description: Complete solution Venn diagram with no shaded region, explicitly identified as empty.
spec.mathematics: The two exclusive regions are disjoint.

children.label: e
children.prompt: $((A^{\mathrm c}\cap B^{\mathrm c})\cup(A\cap B^{\mathrm c}))^{\mathrm c}$

answer.worked:
The region outside both circles together with the $A$-only region is everything outside $B$. Taking its complement leaves all of $B$.
$$\begin{align*}(A^{\mathrm c}\cap B^{\mathrm c})\cup(A\cap B^{\mathrm c})&=B^{\mathrm c}\\((A^{\mathrm c}\cap B^{\mathrm c})\cup(A\cap B^{\mathrm c}))^{\mathrm c}&=B.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete solution Venn diagram; all of B is shaded.
spec.mathematics: The inner union is B complement; its complement is B.
